name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: Recruiter profile URL (/talent/profile/...) of the person to send a new InMail to. Leave empty when replying with Thread ID.

name: threadId
label: Thread ID
help: ID of the conversation to reply in. Leave empty when sending a new InMail.

name: subject
label: Message Subject
help: Subject of a new InMail, up to 200 characters on one line. Leave empty when replying.

name: allowPaidCredit
label: Allow Paid Credit
help: Allow spending a paid InMail credit on this message. When disabled and the message needs a paid credit, the module fails and nothing is sent.
